title: Node details
description: node_exporter-style host view: CPU, load, memory, PSI, disk, filesystems, network, systemd, textfile collector.

panels.title: systemd
panels.description: node_systemd_system_running: 1 when the system state is "running" (no failed units, boot finished).

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of all CPUs per mode (idle not shown; the stack top is total busy).

panels.title: Pressure stall (PSI)
panels.description: Share of wall time in which some (or all, "full") tasks were stalled waiting for the resource.

panels.title: Memory breakdown
panels.description: Stacked: used + buffers + cache + free = total (dashed). Green line: MemAvailable.

panels.title: Disk IOPS
panels.description: Completed requests; reads up, writes down.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time the device had I/O in flight.

panels.title: Filesystem used
panels.description: Disk-backed filesystems (tmpfs/ramfs excluded); same device mounted twice (e.g. / and /nix/store) shows twice.

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Receive up, transmit down (negative), per interface (loopback hidden).

panels.title: Network errors and drops
panels.description: Per interface; flat zero is the healthy case.

targets.expr: max by (exported_device, operstate, duplex, address) (node_network_speed_bytes{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exported_device!="lo"} * 8 * on (job, instance, exported_device) group_left (operstate, duplex, address) node_network_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exported_device!="lo"})

max by (exported_device, operstate, duplex, address) (node_network_mtu_bytes{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exported_device!="lo"} * on (job, instance, exported_device) group_left (operstate, duplex, address) node_network_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exported_device!="lo"})

max by (exported_device, operstate, duplex, address) (increase(node_network_carrier_changes_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exported_device!="lo"}[$__range]) * on (job, instance, exported_device) group_left (operstate, duplex, address) node_network_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exported_device!="lo"})

panels.title: Service states
panels.description: Services that were failed, activating or deactivating at some point in the range (gaps: active or inactive).

defaults.noValue: no service failed or changing state

panels.title: Textfile scrape errors
panels.description: node_textfile_scrape_error: 1 if a .prom file in the textfile directory failed to parse.

panels.title: Collector duration
panels.description: Time each collector took on the last scrape; a slow one delays the whole scrape.
